episode_summary: In this episode, Alex Maldonado shares his expertise on helping first-time buyers navigate unexpected closing costs by using seller credits. He also discusses effective lead generation strategies, including bilingual marketing and optimizing Google Business profiles. Alex emphasizes the importance of understanding client needs and building trust within communities to drive real estate success.
